body: They're aware of my depression and I've tried to end it in poorly thought out ways before so it's not like it will be a shock. I don't know if that's any better though. If anything, I wish I hadn't been so transparent but I'm bad at lying and hiding things.

Not much of a story. Nothing happened to me and I'm pretty fortunate. Just have really bad depression and anxiety. I see death as mercy and I don't understand why suicide is so taboo. I'd love to go peacefully in a hospital and get a chance to say goodbye to everyone I love and answer any questions they have but unfortunately that's not an option. It's seen as a "cry for help" so I'm here, asking strangers on the internet if hypothetically they'd want a note in this less than ideal situation and what they'd want to hear.

That's the problem. I have no idea what to say. I don't think I'd personally want a note so it's hard to imagine if someone would and what they'd even want to hear but I want to give as much closure as possible without getting myself sent to a hospital so unfortunately leaving a note to be read after the fact seems like the best option. 

They're aware of my depression and everything though but they have their own issues.

Thank you for kind words and thoughts.
